# Copilot instructions

All rules for this repository live in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root. Read it before doing anything; its rules are mandatory.

Key points:
- Code, comments and commit messages in English. Only `docs/` is in Spanish.
- Every commit that touches code must also update `docs/miembros/<member>/bitacora.md` and `estado.md` (member = `git config hcd.member`).
